description: Conservative dense-canopy forest cores manually reviewed on 0.4 m orthophotos and intersected with the prior 2025 satellite outlines; split into at most 500 x 500 metre pieces.

coordinate_frame.ring_closure: First vertex is repeated as the last vertex.

viewer_conversion.Y: Sample published terrain at (east, north); heights are not stored here.

limitations: Deliberately incomplete dense-canopy approximation; omitted wooded edges, sparse stands, parks and ambiguous patches are intentional.
Manual cores are inset 20 m and intersected with prior satellite footprints inset 10 m; this is a conservative review policy, not a ground survey.
Orthophotos are from 2016; satellite context is from 2025. Changes after either acquisition cannot be ruled out.
Clearly visible clearings and selected tracks are excluded with safety margins; very small canopy gaps or covered paths may remain.
The EOV CRS override is explicit and inherited from the reviewed local tree-data workflow.
Coordinates are in the published map frame. Subdivision borders are artificial and do not represent forest edges.
source.primary_imagery: 2016 downloaded orthophotos; 2025 Sentinel-2 outlines used as an additional intersection constraint

orthophotos.crs_override_reason: Existing tree-placement workflow explicitly interprets these LOCAL_CS SOCET-SET LSR Curved tile coordinates as Hungarian EOV; the stored CRS alone is insufficient.

subdivision.boundary_policy: Adjacent pieces share edges without overlap. Components below 2500 m² and resulting grid fragments below 2000 m² are deliberately omitted.
